Replays tested on Cursor (IDE + Agent CLI)

No replay has run on Cursor (IDE + Agent CLI). All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Cursor (IDE + Agent CLI).

What the Cursor (IDE + Agent CLI) setup page says about coverage

Cursor decides which tools go through MCP, and its own approval modes can run tools outside it. KYA gates MCP calls only. A Cursor action executed natively is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the Cursor (IDE + Agent CLI) recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
